summary: Etsy-specific error diagnosis in generated error classification and doctor: key-format 403, missing OAuth scope, retry guidance on 429, unconfirmed write as a usage error.
reason: The generic classifier reported Etsy's three distinct 403 causes (bare key, missing scope, inactive app) identically. etsyErrorHint in etsy_errors.go distinguishes them; helpers.go (classifyAPIError, writeAPIErrorEnvelope) and doctor.go call it, and the write-gate refusal carries reason confirmation_required in the JSON envelope.
